description: 道路・橋梁 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 裾野市. 裾野市の道路・橋梁のデータです。 測量用以外の用途で使用する場合：そのまま利用できます。 測量用に複製・利用する場合：測量法（第43条・44条）で定められた手続きが必要です。. Coverage: 裾野市. The portal files it under the publisher 裾野市. It offers 7 resource(s) in geojson, xls, zip. The portal shows 2024-10-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
